lines.speaker: dock_foreman
lines.text: You're not union, you're not customs, and you're not lost, because lost people look at the water. So what are you.

lines.speaker: dock_foreman
lines.text: Berth nine. Four a week, every week, crated in-house so we never see what's inside. Consignor's a shell with a post box and the post box is up in the hills.

lines.speaker: dock_foreman
lines.text: Continuity Holdings. Same signature for eleven years and I've never met a soul from there. Pay's on time, though. Pay's always on time.

lines.speaker: dock_foreman
lines.text: You lot from the future, then? No, don't answer. Everyone on this dock is from somewhere they don't want to discuss.
